passages.note: Chaptered text of SB 880 expanding the statutory definition of 'assault weapon' to close the fixed-magazine/bullet-button loophole.
Senate Floor final-passage vote on SB 880, 24 Ayes to 14 Noes, with McGuire listed among the Ayes.

rows.reasoning: SB 880 (2015-2016) is a single-subject bill that expanded the Penal Code's definition of 'assault weapon' to close the bullet-button/fixed-magazine loophole, extending the existing ban on semi-automatic assault-style weapons while leaving other firearms untouched. McGuire voted Aye on Senate Floor final passage (24-14), matching the rung text 'Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons, while allowing other firearms' and excluding the other rungs, none of which fit a tightening of the assault-weapon definition.
